en: A black-and-white postcard-style photograph showing a forested mountain landscape with tall conifer trees in the foreground. In the left background, a hillside village with clustered light-colored buildings and a church tower is visible. At the bottom center margin of the image, a caption in Italian identifies the place as 'Montagnaga di Pinè.' The picture is framed with a white border typical of early to mid-20th-century postcards.
